warnings: GPS defaults changed: gps_ublox_nav_hz 10→8, gps_ublox_use_galileo and gps_ublox_use_beidou OFF→ON. Backups that still carry the old defaults keep the old values.
pinio_box1..4 defaults changed from NONE to USER1..USER4. A backup without these lines gets the new defaults.
LED pin PWM (led_pin_pwm_mode, ledpinpwm) is replaced by PINIO PWM (piniopwm). Logic condition operation 52 now targets the PINIO channel given by operand B (0 = former LED pin).
Backups taken on 9.0.0: custom special LED colors (mode_color 6 …) map to a different index since 9.1.0. Re-check LED special colors after restore.
